### 1. Homepage Opening **Headline:** Print-ready map layouts for Seabrook’s independent heritage groups **Supporting Line:** We turn your supplied images and captions into a print-ready map PDF, accompanied by a written layout review before you approve a separate print order. --- ### 2. Sample-Page Caption > *[Sample Layout Preview]* > **Caption:** An illustrative map-layout page showing image placement, caption styling, and typographic hierarchy. Demonstrates layout output format; paper, ink, and print production specifications are determined separately. --- ### 3. Action Expectations and Path to Value **Primary Action Label:** `Request a layout-review appointment` **What Happens After Clicking:** Submitting a request sends your details to our team. We will review our schedule and follow up to confirm appointment availability. Submitting a request does not book an instant calendar slot, does not initiate billing, and does not place a print order. **Path to Value:** 1. **Request an appointment:** Submit your group’s project details. We will contact you to confirm appointment availability. 2. **Supply your materials:** Provide your group’s images and captions to be assembled into a print-ready PDF layout. 3. **Receive your written layout review:** Examine the completed layout PDF alongside our written review (layout review fee applies). 4. **Decide on printing:** Use the finalized PDF with your chosen printer, or evaluate and approve a separate print order. --- ### 4. Objection & Clarity: “Am I ordering the full print run?” > **Question: Am I ordering the full print run?** > **Answer:** No. Requesting an appointment and receiving a written layout review does not order or commit you to a print run. The layout review is an independent step with its own fee, designed to check your print-ready map PDF before any press commitment. You review and approve a separate print order only if and when you decide to proceed with printing. --- ### 5.
